resources.string: Capture a game’s resolution, original artwork, comparisons and grouping separately from library-wide noise. Enable before reproducing; the setting survives app restart. Starting a new capture replaces the previous focused log, not the general diagnostics. Maximum 8 MiB; capture pauses when full.
Capture stopped; retained records can still be exported
Capture full — export it, then start a new capture
Capture unavailable or incomplete — check the exported failure status
